## Objective
Stop every Rondo run from 400ing against Linear: remove the dead customFields selection and make deterministic GraphQL schema-validation failures loud.

## Design summary
- Remove the `customFields { ... }` fragments at elixir/lib/rondo/linear/client.ex L256 and L341, the `extract_custom_fields(%{"customFields" => ...})` clause at L950, and any now-dead downstream plumbing of that extraction (trace its callers first; if a caller actually consumes custom-field data in live behavior, PAUSE and report).
- Loudness: when a Linear GraphQL response is a 400 with GRAPHQL_VALIDATION_FAILED, log at error level including the API's message - once per occurrence, not swallowed as a per-poll debug line. Do not crash the poller; this is observability, not new failure semantics.
- Add/extend a test asserting the issue query string contains no customFields and that a validation-failed response produces an error-level log.

## File scope
Include: elixir/lib/rondo/linear/client.ex plus one test file. Exclude: adapter.ex, issue.ex, mcp_server.ex unless a dead reference must be deleted (report it in the final report if so).

## Constraints
No remote writes; local commits only. Do not alter retry/poll semantics.

## Verification
grep -q customFields elixir/lib/rondo/linear/client.ex  # expected exit 1
cd elixir && mix format --check-formatted && mix credo --strict && mix test
